claim.label: incumbent process
claim.sentence: Assembly incumbent process Manual assembly at a bench or a moving line, with jigs, torque drivers and a trained operator absorbing every part variation without anyone writing it down.

value.text: Manual assembly at a bench or a moving line, with jigs, torque drivers and a trained operator absorbing every part variation without anyone writing it down.

assessment.author: editorial
assessment.rationale: Human hands remain extraordinarily good at compliant insertion and at silently compensating for parts that are out of spec — which is exactly what makes the automation gap so persistent.
